overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter supplying premium dehydrated bay leaves from India. Our whole bay leaves undergo a rigorous 6-step process including sourcing, cleaning, sorting, and controlled drying. Sourced to deliver an authentic herbal aroma and warm woody flavor, these dehydrated leaves offer consistent quality and low moisture levels below 10% for reliable industrial formulations.

Designed for bulk supply, wholesale operations, and OEM private label brands, our dried bay leaves maintain stable flavor across extended storage. We provide flexible solutions including whole, crushed, or ground forms with custom packaging and export documentation support. Every batch undergoes visual inspection and quality checks to meet the exact commercial recipe specifications of modern food processing facilities worldwide.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for dried bay leaves?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating commercial trial batches as well as large-scale bulk shipments.

faqs.q: Can you supply custom mesh sizes or crushed bay leaves?
faqs.a: Yes. While standard supply is whole leaf, we provide custom mesh sizes, broken leaves, flakes, and ground powder upon request.

faqs.q: What shelf life and storage conditions are recommended?
faqs.a: The leaves offer a 12-month shelf life when stored sealed in a cool, dry place protected from direct sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you support private label and OEM packaging?
faqs.a: We offer complete OEM and private label services, packing into branded retail pouches, jars, or custom-sized bulk containers.

faqs.q: Are product samples available prior to commercial ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply product samples on request to assist commercial buyers with evaluation, recipe trials, and specification matching.

faqs.q: What export documentation support does TradeNest Naturals provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide standard export documents including commercial invoices, packing lists, specification sheets, and certificates of origin.
